evidence.reason: After edit, calls reminders.evaluate(minutes, 0, "benchmark") and returns value + 3, changing both the multiplier argument and the calendar argument relative to the before version which used 0.1 and "work".

After edit, priorities array is [multiplier/2, multiplier] instead of [multiplier, multiplier/2], so priorities[0] used in the return expression is now multiplier/2, changing the computed delay for any given multiplier.

evaluate value-references reminderDelay, so the left edit's new arguments (0, "benchmark") flow into reminderDelay whose behavior was changed by the right edit; the combined effect is not verifiable from the supplied evidence.
Test only asserts scheduledDelay(40) > 0, which is too weak to detect whether the merged argument/priority changes preserve the intended delay semantics.

result.suggestedAction: 请 src/scheduling.ts 中 scheduledDelay 的调用方确认 evaluate 的 multiplier 与 calendar 参数应取何值，并请 src/reminders.ts 中 reminderDelay 的维护者确认 priorities 顺序调整是否与 evaluate 的调用约定一致，必要时统一修正其中一方的参数或优先级顺序。
